title: Spike instrumentation: F3 spike log, GC counters, perf probes and a perf.cmds baseline
player_outcome: Pressing F3 shows the worst recent hitch and what caused it (for example 'save 40 ms, colliders 12 ms, GC gen2'). This lets every later fix be proven and regressions be caught.
design: Add src/Strata.Core/Diagnostics/SpikeLog.cs. Metrics gets `TrackFrames`; while it is on, Record() also adds into the current frame's totals.

EndFrame(double frameMs) keeps counters for frames over 33, 50 and 100 ms and WorstMs. For frames of 33 ms or more it stores a Spike {frame, ms, top-5 timers, GC gen0/1/2 deltas from GC.CollectionCount, GC pause delta from GC.GetTotalPauseDuration()} in a 64-entry ring.
PerfCommands: add `perf spikes [n]`; `perf report` header adds spike counts and GC counts.
Probes: perf.frames_over_33, perf.frames_over_50, perf.worst_ms, perf.gc2, perf.gc_pause_ms, plus prefix probes perf.max.<timer>, perf.avg.<timer>, perf.calls.<timer> (CommandContext.AddPrefixProbe).

Add game/Debug/FrameProbe.cs, a Node with ProcessPriority = int.MaxValue. It measures the real frame time from Time.GetTicksUsec() deltas (physics + process) and calls Metrics.Frame.EndFrame. WorldLauncher.Launch adds it.

PerfOverlay (F3): opening it turns on Metrics.Frame (today the timers run only after `perf start`). Add the line 'spikes >33 ms N (worst X) · last: 72 ms save.capture 40.1 gd.colliders 12.0 · GC a/b/c pause y ms'.

Add timer scopes at the suspected sources: ColliderManager.Build → gd.colliders.build; TileObjectRenderer.Rebuild → gd.objects.rebuild; GrassRenderer.Create → gd.grass.create; NpcRenderer.Create/Acquire → gd.npcs.create; ProjectileRenderer.Create → gd.projectiles.create; GameWorld.Tick autosave → tick.autosave; ChunkStreamer.FlushSaves → stream.unload_flush; DynamicResolution change → gd.dynres.change.

Add game/Testing/Scripts/perf.cmds (CI runs every Scripts/*.cmds). Sequence: wait_until player.frozen == 0 300 and stream.idle 900; perf start; biome desert / biome tundra / tp spawn, each followed by wait_until stream.idle == 1 900; save; place torch at 10 offsets; liquid water 3 0 3 5 2 5 then wait 3; give a magic weapon, wield it and use ×20; spawn zombie 5; spawn demon_eye 3; perf report 40; perf spikes 10; assert errors == 0; assert perf.worst_ms < 5000 (smoke-only in headless CI). Later WPs add structural asserts.

docs/architecture/rendering.md: new 'Measuring hitches' section covering the F3 spike line, perf start/spikes/report, perf.cmds headless vs rendering runs (dev GPU: --graphics=medium --view=6), and before/after comparison.
